review.notes: Full review. All 15 sampled targets and every headline theorem recomputed: brute force over formulas on two variables for Layers 1, 3, 4.1 and 6, 2998 random formulas for Layer 2, exhaustive and random-walk checks of the transition systems on one and two variables, 4000 random implication trails for conflict analysis. 32 of 32 source locators read in the six sources (arXiv, HAL and authors' pages) and agree; 14 Mathlib and Lean core declarations opened at the pins. Automatic checks all passed; Suggested.lean elaborates with 30 sorry warnings only; no theorem closes with rfl or simp; dependency check 0 problems; no overlap with another roadmap. One small correction (a Check in 4.1 lists part of a closure), one format note (six credited works missing from the References). Scope and licence questions listed for the human reviewers.
